item.title: One of the Gnarliest Nazaré Wipeouts You’ll Ever See Happened Yesterday
item.description: Alberto Truncer took a Nazaré lip on the head during the type of wipeout rarely seen at the Portuguese big wave spot. Reports say he's okay after the incident.

item.title: Gold Coast Carnage: 2 Minutes of Wipeouts from Summer 2026
item.description: If you surf, you wipe out. No one is immune, from the newest of noobs to the Kelliest of Slaters. And on the Gold Coast, there are more surfers to fall.

item.title: This Surf Shop Is Proving the Team Rider Concept Still Works
item.description: WND&WVS, a surf shop on the shores of Vermont's Lake Champlain, is proving that the team rider concept of sports marketing still works. And they're leaning in.

item.title: Mt. Baldy Hiking Will Be Closed Through March 20 Due to Abundance of Snow and Ice
item.description: Angeles National Forest has announced it is extending the closure of hiking trails on Mt. Baldy through March 20. Officials say “an abundance of snow and ice” at higher elevations has created dangerous conditions. item.title: Stephanie Gilmore Has Her Very Own Barbie Doll
item.description: Stephanie Gilmore has eight world titles. She's got more awards than she can count, but says this Barbie doll is just as rewarding as any of them.

item.title: California Regulator Finds Mammoth Mountain at Fault for Ski Patroller Avalanche Death
item.description: A California regulatory agency has found Mammoth Mountain at fault for the avalanche death of a ski patroller last year.

item.title: L.A. Lifeguards Perform Helicopter Rescue of Man Stranded On Palos Verdes Cliffs
item.description: Los Angeles County Lifeguards have reported performing a nighttime hoist rescue along the cliffs of the Palos Verdes Peninsula over the weekend.

item.title: Snow League Debuts ‘Crash Patch’ Sticker Tech That Detects Critical Impacts
item.description: The Snow League, created by Shaun White and dedicated to snowboarding and freeskiing, has launched a pilot program to address head trauma in snowsports.

item.title: Survivors of Lake Tahoe Avalanche that Killed 9 Recount the Tragedy
item.description: For the first time, survivors of what is being called the deadliest avalanche in modern California history have recalled the moments before the tragedy.

item.title: Foiler Takes on Saudi Arabia’s Newest Wave Pool, and It’s Basically an Endless Wave
item.description: Someone had the good idea to put a foiler in a wave pool and see what happens. What happened was basically an infinite wave. The pool is ADRENA in Saudi Arabia.
